description: This file contains Kotlin extension functions for Android's LiveData, providing utility functions such as converting MutableLiveData to LiveData and simplifying the observe syntax with inline functions.

methods.name: asLiveData
methods.description: Converts MutableLiveData to LiveData, providing a read-only view.

methods.name: observe
methods.description: Simplifies observing LiveData changes with inline lambda, mimicking StateFlow-like behavior.
